items.sourceLabel: Internet Hall of Fame · Raymond Tomlinson

proposal.summary: En 1971 Ray Tomlinson adaptó programas existentes para enviar mensajes entre computadores conectados a ARPANET. También eligió el símbolo @ para separar el nombre del usuario del equipo de destino, una convención que terminó formando parte de prácticamente todas las direcciones de correo electrónico.
proposal.expanded: Los computadores ya podían dejar mensajes para otros usuarios de la misma máquina, pero el aporte de Tomlinson fue hacer que esos mensajes viajaran por una red. Trabajando en BBN combinó SNDMSG con CPYNET y creó una forma práctica de identificar usuario y host mediante user@host. El correo creció tan rápido que pocos años después concentraba una parte enorme del tráfico de ARPANET, convirtiéndose en una de las primeras aplicaciones realmente populares de las redes informáticas.

proposal.summary: El primer teléfono comercial con Android llegó en 2008. El T-Mobile G1, también conocido como HTC Dream, mostró un sistema móvil abierto a múltiples fabricantes y a aplicaciones descargables, inaugurando la plataforma que después se extendería por una enorme diversidad de teléfonos.
proposal.expanded: Google y sus socios habían anunciado la Open Handset Alliance en 2007, pero Android se volvió un producto tangible con el G1 en 2008. El dispositivo combinaba pantalla táctil, teclado físico y servicios de Google, mientras Android Market permitía instalar aplicaciones. La decisión de ofrecer el sistema a distintos fabricantes fue crucial: Android no quedó atado a un solo modelo de teléfono y se convirtió en la base de un ecosistema móvil muy amplio.
proposal.dateNote: El año corresponde al primer teléfono comercial con Android, no al anuncio previo de la plataforma en 2007.

items.sourceLabel: DENSO WAVE · QR Code development story

proposal.summary: Denso Wave desarrolló el código QR en Japón en 1994 para identificar piezas con mayor rapidez en procesos industriales. Su diseño podía almacenar más información que un código de barras convencional y leerse con velocidad desde distintos ángulos, características que facilitaron usos muy alejados de la fábrica original.
proposal.expanded: El equipo liderado por Masahiro Hara buscaba un código capaz de manejar más caracteres y de localizarse rápidamente en una imagen. Los tres grandes cuadrados de las esquinas permiten reconocer su orientación. Denso Wave decidió no restringir el uso de la especificación mediante el ejercicio de sus patentes, y con la expansión de cámaras y teléfonos inteligentes el QR pasó de la logística industrial a pagos, entradas, menús y enlaces cotidianos.

23 February 1953. Yalu River Power Plant - Fifth Air Force, Korea. The Suiho power plant, the key Communist industrial complex in the Yalu River in North Korea and Manchuria, is revealed here in an aerial reconnaissance photograph taken at an amazingly low altitude by an RF-80 pilot of the U.S. Air Force 67th Tactical Reconnaissance Wing. This photo, looking northeast (upriver), shows the dam which holds back the Suiho resevoir, and the cement power house at the base of the dam which contains the generators that once supplied power for many of the major industrial centers of North Korea. The shore in the right section of the photo is the southern bank of the Yalu, northern border of enemy-held North Korea. To the left, just out of range of the photo, is Manchuria, the sanctuary for Communist MiG-15's. Despite the nearness to the MiG bases, the pilot of the aircraft made this low photo run in his unarmed jet to get this photograph.

proposal.summary: En abril de 1955 representantes de 29 países asiáticos y africanos se reunieron en Bandung, Indonesia. La conferencia buscó cooperación entre Estados recién independizados o en proceso de descolonización y expresó una voz política que no quería quedar reducida al enfrentamiento entre Estados Unidos y la Unión Soviética.
proposal.expanded: La reunión trató cooperación económica y cultural, colonialismo, derechos humanos y paz internacional. Su comunicado final formuló diez principios sobre soberanía, no agresión, igualdad y solución pacífica de controversias, conocidos como los Diez Principios de Bandung. La conferencia no creó por sí sola el Movimiento de Países No Alineados, fundado después, pero ayudó a construir el lenguaje político y las redes que lo harían posible.

items.title: Primavera de Praga
items.sourceLabel: Institute for the Study of Totalitarian Regimes · 1968

proposal.summary: La Primavera de Praga de 1968 fue un intento de reformar el socialismo checoslovaco bajo Alexander Dubček, ampliando libertades de prensa, debate y participación. En agosto, tropas de la Unión Soviética y otros países del Pacto de Varsovia invadieron Checoslovaquia y frenaron el proceso.
proposal.expanded: Dubček llegó al liderazgo del Partido Comunista en enero de 1968 y promovió un programa descrito como “socialismo con rostro humano”. La relajación de la censura abrió una intensa vida pública y generó expectativas de reforma. Moscú consideró que el proceso amenazaba el control del bloque oriental y en la noche del 20 al 21 de agosto fuerzas del Pacto de Varsovia entraron al país. proposal.summary: Bangladesh proclamó su independencia el 26 de marzo de 1971, rompiendo con Pakistán después de una crisis política y una represión militar. proposal.summary: La Guerra de Yom Kippur comenzó el 6 de octubre de 1973 cuando Egipto y Siria atacaron posiciones israelíes en el Sinaí y los Altos del Golán. La sorpresa inicial alteró la percepción de superioridad militar israelí y desencadenó una crisis regional con efectos diplomáticos y energéticos globales.
proposal.expanded: El conflicto ocurrió durante la festividad judía de Yom Kippur y comenzó con avances egipcios y sirios. Israel recuperó terreno y el enfrentamiento terminó tras resoluciones de alto el fuego impulsadas por Estados Unidos y la Unión Soviética. La guerra abrió un nuevo ciclo diplomático que contribuiría a negociaciones entre Egipto e Israel. Paralelamente, productores árabes de petróleo aplicaron un embargo que profundizó la crisis energética mundial de 1973.

proposal.summary: En 1980 la Asamblea Mundial de la Salud declaró erradicada la viruela, después de una campaña internacional basada en vacunación, vigilancia y respuesta rápida a los últimos brotes. Fue la primera enfermedad humana eliminada del mundo mediante una intervención sanitaria deliberada.

El logro mostró que una enfermedad altamente contagiosa podía desaparecer mediante cooperación global, seguimiento epidemiológico y una vacuna eficaz.

items.title: Invención de la PCR
items.sourceLabel: Nobel Prize · Kary Mullis, Nobel Lecture

proposal.summary: Kary Mullis concibió en 1983 la reacción en cadena de la polimerasa, PCR, una técnica capaz de amplificar fragmentos específicos de ADN hasta producir millones de copias. Esa posibilidad transformó la biología molecular porque permitió analizar cantidades diminutas de material genético con una facilidad antes impensable.
proposal.expanded: La idea de Mullis consistía en repetir ciclos de copia de una región delimitada del ADN usando cebadores y una enzima polimerasa. En su conferencia Nobel recordó experimentos realizados durante 1983 y situó en diciembre la primera reacción que consideró exitosa. La técnica fue perfeccionada después, especialmente con polimerasas resistentes al calor, y terminó siendo fundamental en investigación, diagnóstico médico, genética forense y muchas otras áreas.
proposal.dateNote: El juego toma 1983 como el año de la concepción y primeras pruebas exitosas de PCR; las publicaciones y mejoras técnicas llegaron posteriormente.

proposal.summary: En 1985 científicos del British Antarctic Survey publicaron que la capa de ozono sobre la Antártida estaba adelgazando de forma dramática cada primavera. El descubrimiento convirtió un fenómeno atmosférico remoto en una evidencia contundente de que sustancias producidas por seres humanos podían alterar la química global del planeta.
proposal.expanded: Joe Farman, Brian Gardiner y Jonathan Shanklin analizaron años de mediciones tomadas en la estación Halley y observaron una caída estacional del ozono mucho mayor de lo esperado. El hallazgo ayudó a concentrar la atención internacional sobre los clorofluorocarbonos, CFC, compuestos usados en refrigeración y aerosoles. Dos años después se firmó el Protocolo de Montreal, que restringió sustancias destructoras del ozono y se convirtió en uno de los acuerdos ambientales más exitosos.

learning.expanded: Joe Farman, Brian Gardiner y Jonathan Shanklin analizaron años de mediciones tomadas en la estación Halley y observaron una caída estacional del ozono mucho mayor de lo esperado. El hallazgo ayudó a concentrar la atención internacional sobre los clorofluorocarbonos, CFC, compuestos usados en refrigeración y aerosoles. Dos años después se firmó el Protocolo de Montreal, que restringió sustancias destructoras del ozono y se convirtió en uno de los acuerdos ambientales más exitosos.

items.title: Primeros exoplanetas confirmados
items.sourceLabel: NASA · Will the Real First Exoplanet Please Stand Up?

proposal.summary: En 1992 Aleksander Wolszczan y Dale Frail anunciaron planetas alrededor del púlsar PSR B1257+12, los primeros exoplanetas cuya existencia quedó ampliamente aceptada. El descubrimiento confirmó que podían existir sistemas planetarios fuera del Sistema Solar, aunque aparecieran alrededor de una estrella muerta y muy distinta del Sol.
proposal.expanded: Los planetas se detectaron estudiando pequeñas variaciones en los pulsos extremadamente regulares de una estrella de neutrones. El método permitió inferir la gravedad de cuerpos en órbita sin verlos directamente. El hallazgo de 1992 abrió una nueva etapa de la astronomía planetaria. En 1995 llegaría 51 Pegasi b, el primer exoplaneta descubierto alrededor de una estrella semejante al Sol, otro hito que a menudo se confunde con el primero absoluto.
proposal.dateNote: 1992 corresponde a los primeros exoplanetas confirmados, alrededor de un púlsar. El primer planeta alrededor de una estrella tipo solar se anunció en 1995.

items.title: Primer módulo de la Estación Espacial Internacional

proposal.summary: Zarya fue lanzado el 20 de noviembre de 1998 y se convirtió en el primer componente de la Estación Espacial Internacional. El módulo, construido en Rusia con financiación estadounidense, proporcionó inicialmente energía, control y comunicaciones mientras comenzaba a ensamblarse en órbita uno de los mayores proyectos científicos internacionales.

Desde noviembre de 2000 mantiene presencia humana continua, transformando una sucesión de lanzamientos en un laboratorio permanentemente habitado.

items.title: Primer vuelo espacial tripulado de China
items.sourceLabel: CNSA · Yang Liwei, primer chino en el espacio

proposal.summary: China realizó su primer vuelo espacial tripulado en 2003 con Shenzhou 5. Yang Liwei despegó el 15 de octubre, orbitó la Tierra durante unas 21 horas y regresó al día siguiente, convirtiendo a China en el tercer país capaz de enviar seres humanos al espacio con tecnología propia.
proposal.expanded: La misión despegó desde Jiuquan a bordo de un cohete Long March 2F. Yang completó 14 órbitas antes de aterrizar en Mongolia Interior. Esa experiencia se convirtió en la base de misiones posteriores con caminatas espaciales, acoplamientos y, finalmente, una estación espacial propia.

items.title: Retorno de Hayabusa
items.sourceLabel: JAXA · Retrieval of the HAYABUSA Capsule

proposal.summary: La sonda japonesa Hayabusa devolvió a la Tierra en 2010 una cápsula con material del asteroide Itokawa. Fue la primera misión que consiguió traer muestras de un asteroide, después de un viaje de siete años marcado por fallos técnicos que amenazaron repetidamente con impedir el regreso.

La misión demostró técnicas de navegación, contacto y retorno de muestras que influirían en misiones posteriores como Hayabusa2 y OSIRIS-REx.

proposal.summary: En 2012 Emmanuelle Charpentier, Jennifer Doudna y colaboradores mostraron que el sistema bacteriano CRISPR-Cas9 podía programarse para cortar ADN en lugares elegidos. El trabajo transformó un mecanismo de defensa microbiano en la base de una herramienta de edición genética mucho más simple y adaptable que técnicas anteriores.

La expansión de CRISPR abrió enormes posibilidades en investigación, agricultura y medicina, junto con debates éticos sobre hasta dónde debería llegar la edición del genoma.

proposal.summary: Homo naledi fue anunciado como una nueva especie humana en 2015 a partir de más de 1.500 fósiles recuperados en el sistema de cuevas Rising Star, en Sudáfrica. proposal.summary: Tu Youyou recibió el Nobel de Medicina en 2015 por su papel en el descubrimiento de la artemisinina, un tratamiento contra la malaria derivado de Artemisia annua. proposal.summary: En febrero de 2016 LIGO anunció la primera detección directa de ondas gravitacionales, ondulaciones del espacio-tiempo predichas por Einstein un siglo antes. La forma de la señal coincidía con la fusión de agujeros negros de unas 29 y 36 masas solares. La detección confirmó una predicción central de la relatividad general y permitió estudiar objetos cósmicos mediante vibraciones del espacio-tiempo, no sólo mediante luz.

items.title: Primera imagen de un agujero negro
items.sourceLabel: ESO · First Image of a Black Hole

proposal.summary: En 2019 el Event Horizon Telescope presentó la primera imagen de la sombra de un agujero negro. El objeto era M87*, en el centro de la galaxia Messier 87, y apareció como una región oscura rodeada por un anillo brillante de gas curvado por una gravedad extrema.
proposal.expanded: La imagen no fue una fotografía tomada por una sola cámara. Ocho radiotelescopios distribuidos por el planeta observaron simultáneamente M87* en 2017 y sincronizaron enormes volúmenes de datos mediante relojes atómicos. La técnica de interferometría permitió que la red funcionara como un telescopio virtual del tamaño de la Tierra. Después de años de procesamiento y comprobaciones independientes, el resultado se publicó el 10 de abril de 2019 y ofreció evidencia visual directa de la estructura esperada alrededor de un agujero negro.

candidates.description: My name is Nutsinee Kijbunchoo and I'm a physics PhD student based at the National Australian University, Canberra, Australia. My advisor sent me to LIGO Hanford, one of the two U.S. based gravitational-wave detectors located in the middle of Washington desert to help out with the squeezed light commission and upgrade during the third observing run break (it means we stopped listening to black hole and neutron star collisions). On a rare day that I didn't have to work at my own corner, I followed Georgia Mansell (MIT postdoc) and Jason Oberling (site detector engineer) into the Pre-Stabilized Laser (PSL) enclosure. Inside the PSL is where the laser that uses to detect gravitational waves generates. It is literally where it all begins. The system is capable of outputting 70-80 W of laser power so the room needs to be clean as dust and bugs can cause damage to the coatings. While I was watching Georgia and Jason work I snapped this photo as the two were baffled by the low amount of light coupling into the new fiber coupler they just installed. Just like all equipment, LIGO too needs to be maintained constantly.

candidates.description: The Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) — a planet-scale array of eight ground-based radio telescopes forged through international collaboration — was designed to capture images of a black hole . In coordinated press conferences across the globe, EHT researchers revealed that they succeeded, unveiling the first direct visual evidence of the supermassive black hole in the centre of Messier 87 and its shadow. In this image of M87* taken on 11 April 2017 (a representative example of the images collected in a global 2017 EHT campaign), the shadow of a black hole is the closest we can come to an image of the black hole itself, a completely dark object from which light cannot escape. The black hole’s boundary — the event horizon from which the EHT takes its name — is around 2.5 times smaller than the shadow it casts and measures just under 40 billion km across. While this may sound large, this ring is only about 40 microarcseconds across — equivalent to measuring the length of a credit card on the surface of the Moon. Although the telescopes making up the EHT are not physically connected, they are able to synchronize their recorded data with atomic clocks — hydrogen masers — which precisely time their observations. These observations were collected at a wavelength of 1.3 mm in the 2017 campaign. Each telescope of the EHT produced enormous amounts of data – roughly 350 terabytes per day – which was stored on high-performance helium-filled hard drives. These data were flown to highly specialised supercomputers — known as correlators — at the Max Planck Institute for Radio Astronomy and MIT Haystack Observatory to be combined. They were then painstakingly converted into an image using novel computational tools developed by the collaboration. This image is the average of three different imaging methods after convolving each with a circular Gaussian kernel to give matched resolutions. The image is shown in units of brightness temperature, T b = S λ 2 / 2 k B Ω , where S is the flux density, λ is the observing wavelength, k B is the Boltzmann constant, and Ω is the solid angle of the resolution element.

The black hole has a mass of about twenty times the mass of the Sun and is associated with a Wolf–Rayet star; a star that will become a black hole itself. Thanks to the observations performed with the FORS2 instrument mounted on ESO’s Very Large Telescope, astronomers have confirmed an earlier hunch that the black hole and the Wolf–Rayet star dance around each other in a diabolic waltz, with a period of about 32 hours. The astronomers also found that the black hole is stripping matter away from the star as they orbit each other. How such a tightly bound system has survived the tumultuous phases that preceded the formation of the black hole is still a mystery.

candidates.fileTitle: File:Hubble Pinpoints Optical Counterpart of Gamma Ray Burst in a Distant Galaxy (1997-20-488).jpg
candidates.artist: K. Sahu, M. Livio, L. Petro, D. Macchetto, STScI and NASA
candidates.credit: Hubble Pinpoints Optical Counterpart of Gamma Ray Burst in a Distant Galaxy
candidates.description: This is a false-color Hubble Space Telescope image of the visible fireball which accompanied the gamma ray burst called GRB 970228. This is the first optical image ever taken which associates a gamma-ray burst source with a potential host galaxy. This observation provides strong supporting evidence that gamma-ray bursts are cosmological- they originate in distant galaxies across the universe. The burst was detected on February 28, 1997. The Hubble picture is a combination of two images taken on March 26 and April 7, with the Wide Field Planetary Camera 2 (in planetary camera mode). The arrow points to the fireball, which is a white blob immediately to the upper left of image center. Immediately to the lower right of center is an extended object (roughly resembling an "E") interpreted to be the host galaxy where the gamma-ray burst is embedded. A follow-up image taken on April 7 showed the fireball had faded, but not the extended source, supporting the interpretation it is a host galaxy at great distance. It may be a significant finding that the fireball is offset from the center of the galaxy. This rules out a supermassive black hole that could be at the galaxy's core, as the source of the gamma-ray burst. A more likely explanation is that the burst came from the titanic collision of two neutron stars, or a neutron star with a stellar-mass black hole, in the disk of the galaxy.

candidates.fileTitle: File:Mysterious Fireball from a Cataclysmic Explosion (1997-22-490).jpg
candidates.artist: Elena Pian (ITESRC), Andrew Fruchter (STScI) and NASA
candidates.credit: Mysterious Fireball from a Cataclysmic Explosion
candidates.description: The visible fireball from a titanic explosion in deep space, called a gamma-ray burst, blazes in the center of this image, taken with the CCD camera (Charge Coupled Device) on the Space Telescope Imaging Spectrograph (STIS), a new instrument on Hubble Space Telescope. The burst occurred on May 8, and Hubble observations to acquire the fading fireball were made on June 2. No accompanying object, such as a host galaxy, can be found near the burst. This result adds to the puzzlement over of the source of these enigmatic explosions, because a previous Hubble image of another gamma-ray burst counterpart identified a potential host galaxy. If a galaxy is present, and at the distance suggested by Keck spectroscopy, it is much fainter than our Milky Way. A few faint galaxies are, however, seen several arcseconds from the source. If one of these is the host, then the gamma-ray burst is very far out in the galaxy's halo, well outside the galaxy's stellar disk.

candidates.description: View On Black IN THE COURTHOUSE AREA AND ON CORRIENTES AVENUE, BUSINESSES FEAR THE GHOST OF CLOSURE More than being linked to the actual illness, the H1N1 flu is hitting like a bank run. People are buying up face masks, which are almost useless, but few people are wearing them on the street. Theater owners are looking for strategies. Restaurants are afraid. Photo: My own (any copy or reproduction requires prior permission and/or consultation with the author). If you want the photo, please contact me first by email at nicofoxfiles@hotmail.com Text: By Horacio Cecchi for Página 12. The delivery boy came out balancing five coffees and two sodas on his tray. The sodas in cans. The coffees in plastic cups. “Demand has increased a lot,” said Gustavo, the cashier at the Ulpiano bar, on the corner of Lavalle and Talcahuano, near the courthouses. “For orders?” the reporter asked, naively. “...No, for plastic cups. They always used to ask us to send them in regular cups, but for the past few days they've been asking for disposable cups... Because of the flu,” Gustavo explains. In the courthouse area and on Corrientes Avenue, a target for entertainment venues, the impact of the flu is not measured in microdroplets, but in face masks against the anticipated economic downturn. The early start of the judicial recess, the proximity of seasonal children's activities being suspended, the cold weather, and the contradictory reactions of the average citizen's paranoia at the mercy of the news are wreaking havoc among business owners. Two girls walk by hand in hand, engaged in an animated conversation through their face masks. But there are few face masks in circulation. The reason is unclear. Subway Line B. The train is about to arrive at Carlos Pellegrini station. Past 4:30 in the afternoon. In the train car, there were many people, as usual. A woman wearing a face mask boarded the train and then took it off (?). A young couple of Asian descent, both sitting facing each other and next to the window, had their mouths covered. She with a face mask. He, with a gray scarf. The rest of the passengers had their mouths uncovered, enjoying the immunity of summer. The reporter approached to ask a question, after strategically observing that the young man was reading a book in Spanish. “Why are you covering yourselves like that?” the reporter wanted to know, with the healthy intention of dispelling myths. The girl, to whom the question had not been addressed, looked with a terrified expression at the stranger-without-a-mask who was asking who knows what. She got up without saying a word in a presumed act of genuine (understandable?) self-defense. The boy got up from his seat immediately afterward and followed her. They had arrived at their station. On the street, the first impression was misleading. Besides the two girls having a conversation while wearing face masks, nobody, or fewer than the fingers on one hand, wore the hygienic item over their mouths. Two, five, what's the point, among the thousands who were wandering around at that hour, it's nothing. But the topic has its undercurrent, it circulates beneath the surface, it's perceptible. Something is being whispered. Four friends, seemingly from an office, were crossing Montevideo and Corrientes streets. It was clear they were returning home from their weary demeanor, with the haste of the return journey but with the relaxed banter of post-work jokes. None of them were wearing face masks, but they were talking about it. The one at the far right of the group was animatedly telling the other three that at home he had a mask “like Darth Vader's, with a grille and filter and everything. I'm not worried.” A few blocks back, at Lavalle and Libertad, Víctor, from the Tribunales café, said that “until today everything is normal, but I want to see you on Monday, with the fair everything will be over, seventy percent fewer customers. And it doesn't just affect us, it affects everyone.” For the man, “everything is the product of a kind of psychosis that grips people.” Nobody in the bar was wearing a face mask. Face masks are like ghosts, present to the point of exhaustion, but invisible. In a pharmacy on Corrientes Avenue, whose manager requested anonymity, an unusual line of customers had formed. Almost all of them were asking for face masks and hand sanitizer. But those who managed to get the vital anti-flu filter left the pharmacy without putting it on. How many were being sold? “As many as we have. If you have fifty, all fifty. If you have a thousand, all a thousand. They sell out, and you have to wait for more to arrive, and you don't know when that will be. And hand sanitizer is even worse. There's none left; we had to limit it to one per customer because people were coming in and asking for four or five,” explained the manager, leaning against the counter and whispering so as not to cause a wave of pharmaceutical panic. “This has been going on since the TV started going crazy with the flu news. A couple of days before, not a single one was sold. And they're not very effective, because they get damp from your breath, and you have to throw them away because they become a breeding ground for germs.” The manager had to stop talking. The customers were overwhelming him. “The street vendors on the subway are the ones making a killing,” Méndez asserted confidently, in the back of Los Inmortales, while folding napkins hours before closing time.

candidates.description: Roy brings more than 30 years of passion and innovation to the music industry. Self-taught, he has a deep respect for all music genres. As a teenager, he won the 2nd Rock Festival of the Dominican Republic with his band Crudo. But his romance with Rock would be short-lived. The doors that opened for him professionally were as a vocalist and guitar player with the Puerto Rican band, Los Kenton, who recorded his first composition “Quiero hacerte el amor” which later became a Billboard hit performed by Tito Rojas. Later, Roy joined Wilfrido Vargas Orchestra and toured Europe & Latin America. During those formative years when he performed his native merengue roots, he was also working on a groundbreaking production that would marry his love of rock with his native folklore. Roy’s first production, “Roy Tavaré y el Clan de la Furia” was a phenomenon in the DR. His next two albums continued to be very successful internationally and received much critical acclaim. He experimented with fusions that included Rock, R&B, Hip Hop and Dance with Merengue, Bachata, and Plena. However, Roy soon became a controversial figure in his home country due to his over the top style and lyrics that covered taboo material, he found himself restless and looking for more opportunity in the States. In Sue Steward’s book, “Musica!: The Rhythm of Latin America - Salsa, Rumba, Merengue, and More” Steward refers to Roy as the inventor of sequencers and Merengue-House, paving the way to the meren-house movement. Roy’s ability to move between genres caught the attention of Emilio Estefan and he soon was working on much of Estefan’s top performers remixes creating sounds that would carry their music between formats. On Shakira’s 2nd international release, “Donde están los ladrones?” Roy was re-mixed her tracks providing additional airplay on stations and clubs where Shakira’s rock had limited airplay. Roy’s work crossed all genres from fostering duos on his production with Roselyn Sanchez featuring Tego Calderon and R&B artist Tyrese on salsa track “I wanna feel your rumba”. Additionally, Roy’s production work with Superstar Ricky Martin, “Pégate” showcased his Puerto Rican roots. This plena track soared the charts in the US & Latin America and garnered Roy an ASCAP recognition for his work as a composer. His hits topped all charts ranging from Tito Roja’s salsa, to Toño Rosario’s merengue to Alejandra Guzman’s rock to Alejandro Fernandez’s #1 Billboard Pop charter and most recently Mayra Veronica #1 Billboard Club Track.

candidates.description: On May 22 1960, the Great Chilean Earthquake struck at 15.11 local time. It was the most powerful earthquake ever recorded, measuring 9.5 on the Moment Magnitude Scale. The resulting tsunami affected southern Chile, Hawaii, Japan, the Philippines, eastern New Zealand, southeast Australia, and the Aleutian Islands. The epicentre was near Lumaco, approximately 570 kilometres (350 mi) south of Santiago, with Valdivia being the most affected city. The tremor caused localised tsunamis that severely battered the Chilean coast, with waves up to 25 metres (82 ft). The main tsunami raced across the Pacific Ocean and devastated Hilo, Hawaii. Waves as high as 10.7 metres (35 ft) were recorded 10,000 kilometres (6,200 mi) from the epicentre, and as far away as Japan and the Philippines. Between 3 and 6 thousand people were killed in the disaster. After the earthquake New Zealand set up a Red Cross fund to support victims in Chile. The New Zealand Government offered £10,000 for the fund. The letters shown here are a statement from the New Zealand Government offering support for Chile via the Red Cross Appeal, and a response from the Chilean Foreign Minister thanking New Zealand for its support. These pieces of correspondence are found in the Walter Nash Papers. Other images from the Nash papers have been digitised and are available to view in an online exhibition archives.govt.nz/events/walters-world-nash-collection Notable items in the collection include images of Nash and Indian Prime Minister Nehru and Nash meeting Australian Prime Minister Robert Menzies. These items can be seen in person in the Wellington Reading Room of Archives New Zealand. proposal.summary: El golpe de Estado del 11 de septiembre de 1973 derrocó al gobierno de Salvador Allende y dio inicio a una dictadura militar encabezada por Augusto Pinochet. El quiebre institucional marcó profundamente la política chilena y estuvo acompañado por persecución, prisión, tortura, ejecuciones y exilio de opositores.
proposal.expanded: Las Fuerzas Armadas y Carabineros tomaron el control de puntos estratégicos mientras La Moneda fue bombardeada y Allende murió en el palacio presidencial. Después del golpe se disolvió el Congreso, se restringieron libertades políticas y se estableció una junta militar. Las violaciones sistemáticas de derechos humanos cometidas durante la dictadura fueron posteriormente documentadas por comisiones oficiales y procesos judiciales. El periodo terminó con la transición democrática iniciada en 1990.

candidates.description: Pablo Neruda (Parral, 12 de julio de 1904 – Santiago, 23 de septiembre de 1973). Poeta, escritor, diplomático y político del Partido Comunista de Chile. Senador por la Primera Agrupación Provincial "Tarapacá y Antofagasta", para el período 1945-1953. Pre-candidato presidencial por el Partido Comunista para las elecciones de 1970. proposal.summary: Chile reconoció en 1949 el derecho de las mujeres a votar en elecciones presidenciales y parlamentarias, ampliando una ciudadanía política que hasta entonces estaba restringida. proposal.summary: La televisión chilena tuvo una de sus primeras transmisiones experimentales públicas en 1957, cuando equipos universitarios comenzaron a demostrar que era posible producir y recibir imágenes televisivas localmente. En los años siguientes aparecieron canales ligados a la Pontificia Universidad Católica de Valparaíso, la Universidad Católica de Chile y la Universidad de Chile. Esa etapa experimental permitió formar técnicos, crear programación local y preparar la expansión del medio durante la década de 1960.

La nacionalización modificó de manera duradera la estructura de propiedad del sector y sentó bases para el papel que posteriormente tendría Codelco. El cobre continuó siendo una fuente central de exportaciones e ingresos fiscales para Chile.

candidates.description: Il lettore di Compact Disc presenta uno chassis in lamiera metallica verniciata di nero, dalla forma a parallelepipedo; all'interno dell'apparecchio sono racchiusi i circuiti elettronici e il laser per la lettura del disco. Il vassoio estraibile per l'inserimento del compact disc si trova sul lato anteriore, insieme ai pulsanti di comando. Alla sinistra del comparto per il disco si trovano il tasto per l'accensione (on/off), l'interruttore per la riproduzione con il timer, la boccola per il collegamento della cuffia e il selettore per la regolazione del volume della cuffia. Alla destra del comparto invece sono collocati il display a cristalli liquidi per le informazioni sulla riproduzione e il sensore a raggi infrarossi del telecomando. Immediatamento al di sotto del display si trovano i quattro tasti per l'impostazione della ripetizione programmata delle tracce del disco, il tasto azzeratore ed infine il tasto per la segnalazione del tempo di riproduzione rimasto. Al di sotto di questi comandi secondari, si trovano i tasti per il comando della riproduzione del disco: il tasto di avvio della riproduzione, il tasto di pausa, quattro tasti di ricerca manuale in avanti e all'indietro a due velocità ed infine due tasti per la selezione delle tracce sul disco. Nel pannello posteriore si trova il supporto bipolare per la connessione del cavo di alimentazione; accanto ad esso esce il cavo per il collegamento del lettore all'amplificatore. Sempre sul lato posteriore si trovano inoltre l'interruttore di pausa automatica, l'interruttore anti-scossoni per l'utilizzo del lettore in luoghi soggetti a vibrazioni, due boccole in uscita e un connettore per altri apparecchi, tuttavia chiuso da una copertura in plastica sigillata da nastro adesivo. L'apparecchio è fornito di un telecomando per il controllo a distanza delle operazioni di riproduzione del disco. Funzione Riproduzione di suoni incisi su compact disc Modalità d'uso Collegare il lettore ad un amplificatore. Premere l'interruttore di alimentazione e successivamente aprire il comparto del disco. Inserire il compact disc sul supporto e premere il tasto di avvio della riproduzione (play) Il comparto si chiude automaticamente, iniziando la riproduzione del disco dall'inizio della prima traccia. Notizie storico-critiche Lanciato nell'ottobre 1982, il lettore CDP-101 della Sony inaugurò per primo la rivoluzione digitale nel campo della riproduzione acustica, introducendo un nuovo supporto per la registrazione dei suoni, il compact disc (CD). Il CD venne elaborato dalla collaborazione tra Sony e Philips nata nel 1979, a partire da un'idea iniziale della Philips, sviluppata sul progetto del video disco presentato dall'italiano Antonio Rubbiani al Salone Internazionale della Tecnica nel 1957. Il CD è costituito da un sottile disco in resina termoplastica di 12 centimetri di diametro, nel quale il suono, convertito in un codice binario, viene tradotto attraverso la realizzazione di microscopici fori lungo una spirale, con una distanza di 1,6 micrometri tra le spire; durante la riproduzione, un laser viene diretto sui fori che ne riflettono la luce. Le variazioni nei raggi della luce riflessa vengono ritrasformate in forma di onda audio continua. Attraverso la registrazione digitale, un CD garantisce una qualità di riproduzione irraggiungibile dai precedenti supporti analogici, offrendo inoltre una maggiore capacità di memorizzazione delle informazioni. A partire dalla sua comparsa nel 1982, il CD si è progressivamente diffuso durante gli anni '80 e '90 come supporto principale per la registrazione dei suoni, eclissando i dischi in vinile e le musicassette.

proposal.summary: Breaking Bad siguió la transformación de Walter White desde profesor de química hasta productor de metanfetamina y utilizó ese recorrido para explorar poder, orgullo y justificación moral. La serie convirtió una premisa criminal en un estudio prolongado de cómo decisiones pequeñas pueden acumular consecuencias irreversibles.
proposal.expanded: Creada por Vince Gilligan, la serie comienza cuando White recibe un diagnóstico médico grave y decide fabricar droga junto a un antiguo alumno. Con el tiempo, la motivación económica inicial se mezcla con ambición, control y deseo de reconocimiento. Giancarlo Esposito is a renowned actor, widely recognized for his portrayal of Gus Fring in Breaking Bad and Better Call Saul. He won a Critics' Choice TV Award in 2012 and has garnered several Emmy nominations. Over the course of his career, he has achieved 20 wins and 58 nominations, which include Critics' Choice Awards and Saturn Awards for his performances in Better Call Saul and The Mandalorian. Giancarlo Giuseppe Alessandro Esposito was born in Copenhagen, Denmark, to a father who was an Italian carpenter and stagehand from Naples, Italy, and a mother who was an African-American opera singer from Alabama. His parents, who were working in Europe at the time of his birth, relocated to Manhattan when he was 6 years old, where he spent his formative years. Given his theatrical heritage, it was perhaps unavoidable that young Giancarlo would take to the stage at some point, which he did at the age of 8, making his Broadway debut as a slave child in "Maggie Flynn" in 1966. Subsequent Broadway engagements followed throughout the 1960s and early 1970s, along with minor roles in films. The 1980s saw him transition to television, where he secured increasingly prominent roles in a series of high-profile shows, establishing himself as a character actor both on television and in various films. He gained significant public recognition for his portrayal of Agent Mike Giardello in the television series Homicide: Life on the Street (1993) in 1998, and since that time, he has consistently appeared on our screens. proposal.summary: Los primeros conjuntos de emoji modernos fueron desarrollados en Japón a fines de los años noventa para añadir información visual breve a los mensajes móviles. proposal.expanded: El conjunto original incluía símbolos sobre clima, transporte, emociones y actividades cotidianas, pensados para transmitir información en pantallas pequeñas y con pocos caracteres. La incorporación posterior de emoji al estándar Unicode permitió que los mismos códigos pudieran circular entre dispositivos y sistemas operativos distintos, facilitando su expansión mundial durante la década de 2010.

proposal.summary: Wordle convirtió una palabra diaria de cinco letras en un ritual compartido gracias a una regla sencilla y a la posibilidad de publicar resultados sin revelar la respuesta. Creado por Josh Wardle, pasó de ser un proyecto personal a un fenómeno global en pocos meses.
proposal.expanded: Cada jugador dispone de seis intentos y recibe pistas de color que indican si una letra está ausente, presente o en la posición correcta. Al existir sólo una palabra por día, la experiencia limita el tiempo de juego y sincroniza a toda la comunidad alrededor del mismo desafío. La cuadrícula de resultados compartible ayudó a su difusión en redes sociales. Su crecimiento llevó a que The New York Times adquiriera el juego a comienzos de 2022.
